items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh Ryan Caliocco? Oh Ryan Caliocco. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah. That's right. He had a good vision to me.

ctx.x: Yeah, John Porter was living down on Simon Bollower and what you call him then at that time?
Oh Ryan Caliocco? Oh Ryan Caliocco.
Yeah, yeah. That's right. He had a good vision to me. Yeah, well he. About twelve ten or something like that.
